comments.author: Copilot
Copilot
comments.body:
This component currently ships with a hard-coded `notificationCount` of `3`, which will show a badge for all users even when there are no real notifications. If the real data source isn’t ready yet, default this to `0` (no badge) or accept the count as a prop/query result so the UI reflects actual state.
```suggestion
  const [notificationCount, setNotificationCount] = useState(0);
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: New behavior added here (badge formatting like `99+`, screen reader text, and shake-on-increase animation) is untested. Add unit/integration tests that cover the count formatting and that the shake class toggles only when the count increases.

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
The button removes the default outline (`outline-hidden`) but does not add an equivalent focus-visible style. This makes keyboard focus hard to see in the header. Add a `data-focus-visible:*` (or `focus-visible:*`) ring/outline consistent with the other header controls (e.g., `ProfileDropdown`).
```suggestion
        'hover:bg-gray-100',
        // focus-visible
        'data-[focus-visible]:ring-2 data-[focus-visible]:ring-blue-500 data-[focus-visible]:ring-offset-2 data-[focus-visible]:ring-offset-white'
```
